info.title: TaS API
info.description: Test and Simulation Enabler API. Generated from the request validation schemas the server enforces, so it cannot drift from the implementation.

details.description: Per-field breakdown, carried by validation failures.

ValidationError.description: The request was malformed or failed validation.

Unauthorized.description: No session, or it has expired.

Forbidden.description: The session may not do this (missing CSRF token, disallowed origin).

NotFound.description: The addressed resource does not exist.

Conflict.description: The request cannot be applied to the current resource state.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this client; retry later.
